Overlay sparkline or sparkbar charts on a periodic table

Source: R/ggPSE_sparkline.R
ggPSE_sparkline.Rd

Draws a small time-series chart inside each element tile showing the development of a numeric value over time. Supports both line charts (type = "line") and bar charts (type = "bar").

Usage

ggPSE_sparkline(
  plot = NULL,
  data,
  time_col = "year",
  value_col = "value",
  symbol_col = "symbol",
  type = c("line", "bar"),
  color = "#2166ac",
  color_high = NULL,
  line_width = 0.4,
  point_size = 0.8,
  alpha = 0.85,
  normalize = c("element", "global"),
  show_symbol = TRUE,
  show_axis = FALSE,
  legend_tile = TRUE,
  axis_symbol = NULL,
  axis_position = c("below", "above", "left", "right"),
  axis_width = 0.3,
  axis_height = 0.25,
  axis_color = NULL,
  axis_label_size = NULL,
  axis_title_size = NULL,
  base_size = 10
)

Arguments

plot

A ggplot object from [ggPSE()] or similar. If NULL, a blank table is created with white tile backgrounds.

data

A data frame in long format with one row per element-timepoint.

time_col

Character. Column containing time points. Default "year".

value_col

Character. Column containing numeric values. Default "value".

symbol_col

Character. Column containing element symbols. Default "symbol".

type

Character. "line" (default) or "bar".

color

Character. Line or bar color. Default "#2166ac".

color_high

Character. Optional diverging color for bars above element mean (only for type = "bar"). Default NULL.

line_width

Numeric. Line width. Default 0.4.

point_size

Numeric. Point size. Set to 0 to hide. Default 0.8.

alpha

Numeric. Opacity. Default 0.85.

normalize

Character. "element" (default) or "global".

show_symbol

Logical. Redraw element symbols on top. Default TRUE.

show_axis

Logical. Show a magnified legend tile with a full x-axis.

legend_tile

Logical. Show the magnified legend tile when show_axis = TRUE. Set to FALSE to return the main plot only. Default TRUE. Requires patchwork. Default FALSE.

axis_symbol

Character. Which element to show in the magnified legend tile. Default NULL uses the first element with data.

axis_position

Character. Where to place the legend tile relative to the main plot: "below" (default), "above", "left", or "right".

axis_width

Numeric. Relative width of the legend tile when positioned "left" or "right". Default 0.3.

axis_height

Numeric. Relative height of the legend tile when positioned "above" or "below". Default 0.25.

axis_color

Character. Color of the border highlight on the legend element tile and the line/bar in the legend plot. Defaults to color.

axis_label_size

Numeric. Font size for tick labels (numbers) in the legend tile. Default NULL uses base_size.

axis_title_size

Numeric. Font size for the y-axis title in the legend tile. Default NULL uses base_size.

base_size

Numeric. Base font size. Default 10.

Value

A ggplot or patchwork object.

Details

When show_axis = TRUE, a minimal ruler strip is appended showing a solid horizontal line with tick marks at each time point and labels for the first and last time point only. Requires patchwork.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
prices <- data.frame(
  symbol = c("Li","Li","Li","Li","Li",
             "Co","Co","Co","Co","Co",
             "Ni","Ni","Ni","Ni","Ni"),
  year   = rep(2020:2024, 3),
  price  = c(6, 8, 70, 20, 15,
             30, 50, 80, 35, 25,
             14, 18, 25, 21, 17)
)

# Line chart, no axis
ggPSE() |>
  ggPSE_sparkline(prices, time_col = "year", value_col = "price")

# With magnified legend tile below
ggPSE() |>
  ggPSE_sparkline(prices, time_col = "year", value_col = "price",
                  show_axis = TRUE, axis_symbol = "Li")

# Bar chart with legend tile to the right
ggPSE() |>
  ggPSE_sparkline(prices, time_col = "year", value_col = "price",
                  type = "bar", show_axis = TRUE,
                  axis_symbol = "Co", axis_position = "right")

# Transition metals only
ggPSE(groups = c(3, 12), periods = c(4, 6),
      lanthanides = FALSE, actinides = FALSE) |>
  ggPSE_sparkline(prices, time_col = "year", value_col = "price",
                  show_axis = TRUE, axis_symbol = "Li", axis_height = 0.3)
} # }
